name: Yuri
source:
You haven’t come in contact with Yuri all too often, but you get the feeling you won’t get along. He has a cool and egotistical personality, hates women, and is a neat-freak. He doesn’t say much. Other members of the same Mafia fear him, but the leaders have faith in him due to his skill in getting the dirty jobs done right. He has a younger brother called Vito, but his whereabouts are currently unknown, so Yuri is searching for him. He is strict with both himself and others. He has always regretted the fact he couldn’t save his younger sister.

[Source: [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.mafiakaigai]Google Play[/url]]
